mapper.sql: select rate_id, base_currency, quote_currency, rate, version, effective_from, effective_to, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from exchange_rate
mapper.select: where base_currency = #{baseCurrency} and quote_currency = #{quoteCurrency} and status = 'ACTIVE' and effective_from <= sysdate() and (effective_to is null or effective_to >= sysdate()) order by effective_from desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into exchange_rate (base_currency, quote_currency, rate, version, effective_from, effective_to, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{baseCurrency}, #{quoteCurrency}, #{rate}, #{version}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
